findings.note: 1502ec0 (contract A9): js_measure.mjs measures /read?demo=1 and /read?story=<code> (the placeholder cloud answered with the house tape) until the Player's cover shows, counting every same-origin script requested; js-budget.json binds both at 170 KB. fc12162 brings them under: demo 165 KB, share link 168 KB.

fc12162: loadPlayer() is called as every tape open starts (share, demo, file, shelf) and is the dynamic() loader, with the threading reels as its loading view and a Try again view if the fetch fails. 362b537 corrects the decisions.md claim; the ReadRoom comment says what the code does.

fc12162: loadSupabase drops a rejected import so the next call fetches again; cloud-storage's cloudModule() turns a failed fetch into CloudError('network') for save, update, shelf read, share and delete. The Player, end card, panel and library loaders drop failures the same way.

1502ec0: js_budget.py builds with a placeholder cloud project. fc12162: getUser() loads the client only when a supabase-js sign-in is stored on this device, and a share link resolves without the client (share-lookup.ts), so the configured build's /read is 161 KB with nothing deferred past the measurement.
